description: Find the probate forms for a jurisdiction: each form's name, code, description, official court source link (when known), and SwiftProbate page, plus whether it is a county-specific or statewide form. Some states (e.g. Florida) publish no statewide fill-in forms — pass the county to get the usable county-level forms.

county.description: County name to surface that county's own forms first. Omit for statewide.

query.description: Optional keywords to narrow results, e.g. 'small estate affidavit', 'letters testamentary'.

state.description: Two-letter code, full name, or slug of the US state.

name: find_probate_forms
